name: Tactical Combat Overhaul
author: Reaper
description: RTS-style fleet command with fog of war, bigger battlefields and new objectives. Grounded combat: armor penetration and ricochets, limited ammo with resupply ships, reactor power, fires, cook-offs and slow ship deaths. Radar and IR missiles with flares, jamming and datalinks. Board and capture ships deck by deck, rescue escape pods, repair and tow mid-battle. NPC fleets play by the same rules. Works with ship and weapon mods.
